But still the root problems of poverty remained dark to her, and she became convinced that nothing but accurate and scientific exploration of the depths would reveal the currents leading to degradation.

arxiv-2109-12102.title: Exact Percolation Probability on the Square Lattice
arxiv-2109-12102.creator: Stephan Mertens
arxiv-2109-12102.description: Abstract We present an algorithm to compute the exact probability R n ​ ( p ) R_{n}(p) for a site percolation cluster to span an n × n n\times n square lattice at occupancy p p . The algorithm has time and space complexity O ⁡ ( λ n ) O(\lambda^{n}) with λ ≈ 2.6 \lambda\approx 2.6 .

arxiv-2302-01406.title: The role of scalar and mass interactions in a relativistic model of the charmonium spectrum
arxiv-2302-01406.creator: M. De Sanctis
arxiv-2302-01406.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by M. De Sanctis. Lorentz scalar and mass interactions are studied in more detail in the framework of a reduced Dirac equation for heavy quark-antiquark mesons. A microscopic model for these interactions is proposed and analyzed. The charmonium mass spectrum is reproduced by means of two free parameters; a third parameter is fixed by means of a phenomenological hypothesis in accordance with the model.

arxiv-2307-12384.title: Structural and double magnetic transitions in the frustrated spin- 1 2 \frac{1}{2} capped-kagome antiferromagnet (RbCl)Cu 5 P 2 O 10
arxiv-2307-12384.creator: S. Mohanty, J. Babu, Y. Furukawa, R. Nath
arxiv-2307-12384.description: Abstract The structural and magnetic properties of the geometrically frustrated spin- 1 / 2 1/2 capped-kagome antiferromagnet (RbCl)Cu 5 P 2 O 10 are investigated via temperature dependent x-ray diffraction, magnetization, heat capacity, and 31 P NMR experiments on a polycrystalline sample.

arxiv-2307-15503.title: The Applicability of Federated Learning to Official Statistics
arxiv-2307-15503.creator: Joshua Stock, Oliver Hauke, Julius Weißmann, Hannes Federrath
arxiv-2307-15503.description: Abstract This work investigates the potential of Federated Learning (FL) for official statistics and shows how well the performance of FL models can keep up with centralized learning methods. FL is particularly interesting for official statistics because its utilization can safeguard the privacy of data holders, thus facilitating access to a broader range of data.

arxiv-2407-01839.title: The Dynamical Origins of the Dark Comets and a Proposed Evolutionary Track
arxiv-2407-01839.creator: Aster G. Taylor, Jordan K. Steckloff, Darryl Z. Seligman, Davide Farnocchia, Luke Dones, David Vokrouhlický, David Nesvorný, Marco Micheli
arxiv-2407-01839.description: Abstract So-called ‘dark comets’ are small, morphologically inactive near-Earth objects (NEOs) that exhibit nongravitational accelerations inconsistent with radiative effects. These objects exhibit short rotational periods (minutes to hours), where measured. We find that the strengths required to prevent catastrophic disintegration are consistent with those measured in cometary nuclei and expected in rubble pile objects.

arxiv-2502-00616.title: Congestion Management in High-Performance Interconnection Networks Using Adaptive Routing Notifications
arxiv-2502-00616.creator: Jose Rocher-Gonzalez, Jesus Escudero-Sahuquillo, Pedro J. Garcia, Francisco J. Quiles
arxiv-2502-00616.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jose Rocher-Gonzalez, Jesus Escudero-Sahuquillo, Pedro J. Garcia, Francisco J. Quiles. The interconnection network is a crucial subsystem in High-Performance Computing clusters and Data-centers, guaranteeing high bandwidth and low latency to the applications’ communication operations. Unfortunately, congestion situations may spoil network performance unless the network design applies specific countermeasures. Adaptive routing algorithms are a traditional approach to dealing with congestion since they provide traffic flows with alternative routes that bypass congested areas.

arxiv-2510-14397.title: The number of rational iterated preimages of the origin under unicritical polynomial maps
arxiv-2510-14397.creator: Kaoru Sano
arxiv-2510-14397.description: Abstract . We study rational iterated preimages of the origin under unicritical maps f d , c ​ ( x ) = x d + c f_{d,c}(x)=x^{d}+c . Earlier works of Faber–Hutz–Stoll and Hutz–Hyde–Krause established finiteness and conditional bounds in the quadratic case.

arxiv-2512-10364.title: Spectral bounds for vertex-weighted Laplacians of simplicial complexes
arxiv-2512-10364.creator: Yueli Han, Lu Lu
arxiv-2512-10364.description: Abstract The vertex-weighted Laplacian naturally extends the combinatorial Laplacian for simplicial complexes. Inspired by Lew’s foundational techniques for vertex-weighted Laplacians, we present a comprehensive spectral analysis of this operator. First, we determine how basic operations, including joins, complements, and Alexander duals, affect its spectrum.

pmc-11485312.creator: Weizhao Lu, Yanhua Duan, Kun Li, Zhaoping Cheng, Jianfeng Qiu
pmc-11485312.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). INTRODUCTIONAbdominal adipose tissue (AT) mass has adverse effects on the brain. pmc-13475094.title: Cost-effectiveness of the IMPALA monitoring system for hospitalised children in low-resource settings: a pragmatic before-and-after study

pmc-13475094.description: BackgroundStaff shortages, limited training and inadequate hospital equipment often delay responses to patient deterioration in low-resource settings. pmc-13535790.creator: Hui Wang, Jette Möller, Yajun Liang, Imre Janszky, Krisztina D. László
pmc-13535790.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Key PointsQuestionAre higher maternal body mass index in early pregnancy and gestational weight gain associated with cardiovascular disease (CVD) risk in offspring?FindingsIn this cohort study of Swedish national registry data for 2 496 335 offspring, CVD risk was higher among those exposed to maternal overweight and increased with the severity of obesity; greater maternal gestational weight gain was also associated with elevated CVD risk.
